Markets.title: Global Market: China, Hong Kong stocks slip as technology shares extend losses
Markets.summary: Stocks in China and Hong Kong fell because losses in technology and AI shares outweighed positive economic data and central bank support. The decline occurred despite faster industrial-profit growth and fresh liquidity measures from China's central bank.

Markets.title: Jio Platforms shares to list on BSE, NSE tomorrow;  GMP signals 22% premium
Markets.summary: Jio Platforms shares will list on the BSE and NSE on October 28 following an IPO that raised Rs 30,213 crores and was subscribed 22.19 times. The stock is signaling a 22% premium in the grey market ahead of its market debut.

Markets.title: Global Market: Yuan holds near four-year high as China tempers appreciation pace
Markets.summary: China's yuan remained near a four-year high against the US dollar as the central bank slowed its appreciation pace with a moderated daily fixing. Stronger industrial profits and export demand supported the currency while markets awaited major central bank decisions.

Markets.title: Global Market: Japan’s Nikkei rises nearly 2% on AI optimism, Anthropic IPO filing
Markets.summary: Japan's Nikkei index rose nearly 2% to break a three-day losing streak. The gain was driven by Anthropic's US IPO plans and strong performance in American semiconductor stocks, which boosted AI-related companies like Advantest, SoftBank, and Tokyo Electron.

Markets.title: Why AI stocks rallied after Anthropic’s IPO filing
Markets.summary: Anthropic's IPO paperwork announcement drove a rally in AI stocks, pushing Nvidia and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up by nearly 3%. These potential public listings, along with those from OpenAI, are expected to establish new valuation benchmarks for the sector despite ongoing concerns over high spending and financing costs.

Markets.title: Indian bonds tick up on calm oil before Fed verdict
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds edged higher in early trade as oil prices stabilized following a recent surge. Traders remained cautious ahead of the upcoming US Federal Reserve policy decision.

Geo-Political.title: Lula wins fourth term in dramatic Brazil election comeback
Geo-Political.summary: Left-wing incumbent president Lula defeated right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro in a dramatic election comeback. This victory secures Lula's fourth term as the president of Brazil.

Geo-Political.title: Ex-FBI chief James Comey faces federal charges for third time
Geo-Political.summary: Former FBI Director James Comey is facing federal charges for a third time. His lawyers state the case involves the alleged disclosure of classified information to the New York Times in 2016.

Geo-Political.title: Jordan carries out deadly strike in Syria in retaliation for church attack
Geo-Political.summary: Jordan conducted a deadly military strike in Syria in retaliation for a prior church attack. Syrian health officials reported that the strike killed five people, including women and children.

Geo-Political.title: Meghan to co-host Junior MasterChef Australia
Geo-Political.summary: Meghan Markle, the Duchess of Sussex, will co-host an upcoming season of Junior MasterChef Australia. The cooking competition program is scheduled to air next year.

Geo-Political.summary: Rapper Jay-Z will headline the Super Bowl half-time show for the first time. Although he has been involved with the NFL championship event for years, he has never previously performed as an artist.

Data & Insights.title: India loses top EM spot in September as Vietnam surges in exports, stocks
Data & Insights.summary: India lost its top emerging market ranking in September as Vietnam surged ahead in exports and stock performance. Although India's domestic macro fundamentals remain strong, it faces vulnerabilities from foreign capital outflows and market weaknesses.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | From Goa to Uttarakhand: how states are pushing for bottle recycling
Data & Insights.summary: Indian states are implementing Deposit Return Schemes to tackle plastic packaging waste by rewarding consumers who return eligible containers. Goa is starting with liquor packaging, while Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh are developing broader recycling programs.

Data & Insights.title: This week could help decide whether the Fed raises interest rates in December
Data & Insights.summary: Market trends, oil prices, and upcoming economic data will influence the Federal Reserve's decision on whether to raise interest rates in December. This week's developments could push the central bank in either direction.

Data & Insights.title: World's largest real-time payment system; 2,400 crore monthly transactions: FM Sitharaman on India's UPI revolution
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Sitharaman announced that India's UPI is the world's largest real-time payment system, processing 2,400 crore monthly transactions. She highlighted this digital payment growth during the inauguration of the Reserve Bank of India's Bhubaneswar campus.

Data & Insights.title: Centre committed to reducing fiscal deficit, national debt to be capped at 50% of GDP by 2030: FM Sitharaman
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated the government will reduce the fiscal deficit and limit national debt to 50% of GDP by 2030. She also emphasized ongoing efforts to control inflation and shield consumers from sudden price increases.

Data & Insights.title: SBI chief CS Setty expects further 50 bps rate hikes in December, rules out retail loan quality concerns
Data & Insights.summary: State Bank of India Chairman CS Setty expects interest rates to increase by 0.50 percentage points in December before pausing in February 2027. He stated that while higher rates may reduce discretionary spending, they will not harm retail loan quality due to projected 7.1% economic growth.

India.title: Students vs Jamia Continues, University Gives Last Warning To Vacate Site
India.summary: Jamia Millia Islamia has given students a final warning to vacate the ongoing protest site on campus. Meanwhile, the university administration has revoked previous suspension orders and show-cause notices issued during the agitation.

India.title: AIBE 22 Registration 2026: Last Date To Apply Today, Check Fees, Eligibility Details
India.summary: The Bar Council of India is closing the registration window for the AIBE XXII exam today, October 27, 2026. Eligible candidates must complete their applications before the deadline.

India.title: "You Are World's Biggest NGO, Just get Registered": Priyanka Kharge To RSS
India.summary: Karnataka Minister Priyank Kharge has publicly challenged the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) to register as an organization, describing it as the world's biggest NGO. He also accused the RSS of engaging with lobbyists in the United States who simultaneously lobby for Pakistan.

India.title: Kashmiri Pandit Activist Arrested For Circulating Doctored Terror Threats
India.summary: A Kashmiri Pandit activist was arrested for circulating doctored terrorist threats purportedly from the groups Soldiers of Resistance and United Liberation Council. The investigation has established preliminary evidence of an offense related to cyber terrorism.

India.title: Defence Ministry Arm, AI Firm Sarvam Sign Pact For Tri-Service AI Initiatives
India.summary: The Indian Defence Ministry's innovation arm has partnered with AI firm Sarvam to develop artificial intelligence initiatives for the armed forces. This agreement supports the government's objective of achieving self-reliance and indigenization in the defense sector.

India.title: Audio Clip, Rebel Rivalries, Portfolio: Battles Shaking Mahayuti's Stability
India.summary: Maratha quota activist Manoj Jarange Patil released a controversial audio clip alleging a Rs 500 crore transaction involving Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde. This accusation has created serious political ripples and threatened the stability of the ruling Mahayuti alliance.

General.title: Israel heads to polls for pivotal election defined by security and democracy
General.summary: Israel is holding a pivotal election focused on security and democracy. Voters face the possibility of weeks or months of political wrangling because neither leading bloc is expected to win a majority.

General.title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help
General.summary: The chancellor plans to eliminate tariffs on certain staple goods. This measure aims to help households manage the cost of living.

General.summary: Harry Kane has become the first English player to win the men's Ballon d'Or since Michael Owen in 2001. Additionally, Spain midfielder Alexia Putellas won the Ballon d'Or Feminin for a record-equalling third time.

General.summary: Storm Boelo cut power to thousands of homes after striking the region. A yellow wind warning took effect across western Britain and parts of Northern Ireland on Monday evening.
